name: Neltuma

project_scope.selection_mode: Master Plant Pool approved source; build genus module, species installation independent
project_scope.duplicate_policy: Prosopis glandulosa and Neltuma glandulosa are the SAME accepted taxon. ONE species ID should be neltuma-glandulosa; do NOT create prosopis-glandulosa.
project_scope.native_range: Texas native at state scale per POWO; no strict three-target-county verification performed.
project_scope.current_status: Exactly one source-pool species installed with verified-license photo; other proposed comparisons not installed.

look_here_first: LOOK FOR A LONG PENDANT CREAM/YELLOW FLOWER SPIKE and elongated often straw-brown pods (not a round yellow flower ball). A typical leaf has 1–2(occasionally more) pairs of pinnae, each bearing many longer leaflets. Check node spines and the entire compound leaf.

shared_traits: Woody thorny mimosoid legumes; large open tree crown with deeply fissured darker bark when mature.
BIPINNATE leaves (petiole → primary pinnae → secondary small leaflets), generally fewer primary pinna pairs and longer secondary leaflets than huisache.
Cream to yellowish cylindrical flower SPIKES, not globular yellow heads.
Long narrow yellowish-tan fleshy/pulpy mesquite pods; pod color and form are a strong genus cue.
Thorns can be paired at nodes and variable; thorn presence alone does not distinguish from Vachellia.
priority: SHAPE of whole inflorescence: long spikes vs round heads
Count primary PINNA pairs on one entire leaf
Measure leaflets with a ruler, not from cropped photo
Inspect long straight/twisting mesquite pods vs short fat huisache pods
Check paired nodal spines vs Senegalia prickles along internodes
study_strategy.warning: Kew currently treats Texas honey mesquite as Neltuma glandulosa, synonym Prosopis glandulosa. Texas A&M and older sources continue using Prosopis glandulosa. Teach one taxon with both names.

quick_key.if: long pale yellow catkin-like flower spikes; 1–2 primary pinna pairs often; long straw-colored pods
quick_key.then: Neltuma glandulosa — honey mesquite (syn. Prosopis glandulosa)

quick_key.if: bright yellow spherical puffball flowers; dense miniature leaflets; stout black fat pods
yellow spherical flower heads; paired white spines; very slim pod
white to cream globose flower head and hooked catclaw prickles
creamy cylindrical flower spikes and distinctly curved catclaw prickles
quick_key.then: Senegalia greggii / S. wrightii; check leaflets and seed pods

visual_comparison.memory_rule: MESQUITE = LONG FLOWER SPIKES + LONG PALE PODS; HUISACHE = ROUND GOLD HEADS + SHORT DARK FAT PODS.
